articles.summary: Christina Wells, SVP Operations & People at Flo Recruit spoke with David Adams, Director of Programs and Data at Cardozo School of Law’s Office of Career Services, about Cardozo’s partnership with Flo Recruit which began in November 2020.
articles.title: Empowering Future Lawyers: How Cardozo School of Law Uses Flo Recruit to Prepare Students for a Changing Job Market
